Get your heart rate up with this 15-minute FAST low impact cardio workout! This no-equipment cardio workout uses upbeat 150 BPM instrumental music to keep you moving at a faster pace without jumping or high-impact exercises.
• 15 minutes
• 150 BPM instrumental music
• No equipment needed
• Fast-paced, low impact cardio
• No jumping
This workout can be done on its own or added to your regular exercise routine. Take the intensity up or down as needed and work at a pace that feels right for you.
